$comment: Two gaps with one symptom. This bar covers the one filed: provenance the engine already receives and discards. It does NOT cover ADR-033's condition 3, which is about the get_provenance METHOD having no engine consumer -- a separate decision the maintainer owns.

criteria.$comment: Asserts BOTH inputs: a populated execution block cites its source, and an item with no root cites nothing. A fix that unconditionally appends would pass the first and fail the second.
ADR-033's tripwire, generalized from one role to every role and from a text scan to an AST walk. A call site it cannot resolve is now reported rather than skipped.
The ADR index's runtime-dependency claim is now derived from engine/ and the bound adapters, by the method RATIFICATION-v0.1.0.md itself prescribes.
The line itself. Weak alone -- a comment would match -- which is why the suite above is the real criterion and this only pins where the change lives.

criteria.target: grep -q 'Runtime-dependent and still' docs/adrs/README.md && ! grep -q 'none is referenced by the runtime' docs/adrs/README.md
criteria.$comment: Both halves: the true claim is present AND the false one is gone. Asserting only the first would pass with both sentences in the file.
